Phase 66 plan: docs/phases/roadmap-dependency-problems-name-their-line.md @ 340cb32 (branch of the same name, from main @ 3.14.3). The arbiter asked me to finish the remaining items in the issues log; this is issue 9, the last code item.

Defect: roadmap check prints "<slug>: unknown dependency '<text>'" with no location. On 2026-09-20 one bad 'Depends on:' line in each of two projects (free text after the phase reference) took a grep to find. The Phase 60/63 warnings already carry '(line N)'; the fatal edge problems do not.

Plan (tagteam/roadmap.py only): RoadmapPhase gains line: int = 0 and dep_lines: dict[str,int], appended after suffix for positional compatibility (the Phase 59 rule); _split_dep_refs() returns (ref, offset-in-section); parse_roadmap() converts to document lines and records dep_lines keyed by the same value it puts in depends_on (resolved slug or verbatim ref); validate_graph() appends ' (line N)' to 'unknown dependency' and 'depends on itself' when the line is known. Hand-built phases (several tests, worktree's text path goes through parse so it gets lines) keep today's exact strings. Identity and cycle problems are out of scope on purpose.

Please press on: (1) two new dataclass fields vs a side table returned by parse — I chose fields because validate_graph() takes only the phase list; (2) a dict field on a dataclass that may be compared/hashed somewhere — I found no hashing of RoadmapPhase, please check; (3) the watcher's pause_reason string changes (one test expectation) — anything that parses that string?

Verified: tagteam roadmap check ok (67 phases). No code changed; suite not run (plan cycle). Environment note: this repo's .venv was repaired in place today (venv re-run over it + force-reinstall of pip/pytest/pygments to fix console-script shebangs pointing at the old ai-handoff path); pytest is now 9.1.1 and I do not know what it was before — it is unpinned. The next gate run is the first full suite on it.

Approved plan at 340cb32 (current HEAD 7b4b4e8 adds an unrelated issue-log note). The location metadata belongs on RoadmapPhase because validate_graph receives phases, and appending defaulted fields preserves positional callers. RoadmapPhase is already a mutable, unhashable dataclass; I found no hashing consumer. Watcher handling tests pause_reason truthiness or its stable category prefix, so appending locations preserves its control flow.

Implementation guidance: make the diagnostic-only line and dep_lines fields compare=False (and use default_factory=dict), preserving semantic phase equality. There is a concrete existing parsed-versus-hand-built equality assertion at tests/test_roadmap.py:92; avoid changing phase equality merely because blank lines moved. Test the new location fields explicitly.

Preserve the FIRST line after reference resolution as well as before it: Phase 1, its name, and its slug can resolve to the same dependency. Set dep_lines only when first appending the resolved value (or use setdefault), and add an alias-duplicate case alongside the repeated-verbatim case. Use n > 0 for the location suffix as the scope promises, rather than the truthiness shorthand in Technical Approach. The heading_line + section offset calculation matches the current heading regex and section slicing.

Small documentation correction during implementation: worktree._phases_from_text routes through parse_roadmap, so it receives source locations; it is not an example of hand-built phases without line data (the submission correctly distinguishes this, the Scope paragraph does not).

The listed fixtures cover the actual defect and boundary conditions without changing reference resolution, identity errors, or cycle messages. No suite run for this plan review. The first implementation gate will also exercise the repaired venv noted by the lead.
